## Purpose of the website

The Digital Duck Pond is a personal, non-commercial maker blog documenting creative and technical projects, experiments, and learning experiences.

The website covers topics including 3D printing, electronics, programming, DIY projects, and other maker-related activities.

Its purpose is to share personal experiences, project documentation, tutorials, and ideas with others interested in making and learning.

## Disclaimer

The projects, tutorials, designs, and code published on this website are based on my personal experiences and experiments.

While I make reasonable efforts to provide accurate and useful information, I cannot guarantee that all information is complete, up to date, error-free, or suitable for every intended application.

Projects involving electronics, electrical components, machinery, tools, or 3D-printed parts may involve risks. Readers are responsible for assessing these risks and taking appropriate safety precautions.

The information provided on this website is not a substitute for professional technical or safety advice where such advice is required.
